description: Read Hyperliquid's public perpetuals and spot data from a workflow: mid prices, perpetual and spot markets, order books, recent trades, price candles, funding history and predicted funding against Binance and Bybit, and validators; and for any address, its positions, spot balances, open orders, fills, funding payments, order history and status, portfolio history, vaults and staking. Triggers start a workflow when an address gets a fill or a new perpetual is listed. It only reads public data: it cannot place orders or move funds, and nothing it returns is investment advice. No account or API key required.
